rules.name: capitalized-first-letter
rules.message: Your commit must begin with a capital letter.

rules.name: sentence-ending-punctuation
rules.message: Your commit must end with a period, exclamation mark, or question mark.

rules.name: word-colon-sentence
rules.message: Your commit must contain a structure like 'Feature: Implemented something.'

rules.name: geographic-reference
rules.pattern: \b(Alabama|Alaska|Arizona|Arkansas|California|Colorado|Connecticut|Delaware|Florida|Georgia|Hawaii|Idaho|Illinois|Indiana|Iowa|Kansas|Kentucky|Louisiana|Maine|Maryland|Massachusetts|Michigan|Minnesota|Mississippi|Missouri|Montana|Nebraska|Nevada|New Hampshire|New Jersey|New Mexico|New York|North Carolina|North Dakota|Ohio|Oklahoma|Oregon|Pennsylvania|Rhode Island|South Carolina|South Dakota|Tennessee|Texas|Utah|Vermont|Virginia|Washington|West Virginia|Wisconsin|Wyoming|Anhui|Fujian|Gansu|Guangdong|Guizhou|Hainan|Hebei|Heilongjiang|Henan|Hubei|Hunan|Jiangsu|Jiangxi|Jilin|Liaoning|Qinghai|Shaanxi|Shandong|Shanxi|Sichuan|Yunnan|Zhejiang|Beijing|Chongqing|Shanghai|Tianjin|Guangxi|Inner Mongolia|Ningxia|Tibet|Xinjiang|Hong Kong|Macau)\b
rules.message: Your commit must mention at least one US state or Chinese provincial-level region.

rules.name: european-capital
rules.message: Your commit must reference at least one European capital.

rules.name: even-alphanumeric-count
rules.message: Your commit must contain an even number of alphanumeric characters. Punctuation and whitespace do not count.

rules.name: triple-letter
rules.message: Your commit must contain three consecutive identical letters. Go on, make it awkward.

rules.name: positive-descriptors
rules.message: Your commit must include at least two different positive descriptors. Try being more optimistic.

rules.name: dog-name
rules.message: Your commit must mention a dog by name. Any dog. Just name one.

rules.name: uppercase-vowels
rules.message: Every vowel, including Y, must be uppercase. LOWERCASE VOWELS ARE UNACCEPTABLE.

rules.name: capitalization-limit
rules.message: No more than 75% of alphabetical characters may be uppercase. Stop shouting.

rules.name: palindrome
rules.message: Your commit must contain a palindrome of at least five letters. You can do this.

rules.name: orange-rhyme
rules.message: Your commit must contain a word that rhymes with orange. Linguistic precision is optional.

rules.name: digit-sum
rules.message: The individual digits in your commit must add up to exactly 25.

rules.name: unique-commit-title
rules.message: This commit title has already been used in the last 50 commits. Be more original.
